moments.title: The Hundred Continues
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament continues today with double-headers in Cardiff and London, featuring Welsh Fire vs Trent Rockets and MI London vs London Spirit.

angles.name: Match Day Buzz
angles.copy: It's another big day in The Hundred! Welsh Fire take on Trent Rockets in Cardiff, while MI London clash with London Spirit at The Oval. Who are you backing today?

angles.name: Cardiff Local Angle
angles.copy: Welsh Fire are in action today at Sophia Gardens! Get behind our team as they face Trent Rockets in The Hundred. Are you watching?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Top 40
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean hold the #1 spot on the UK Official Singles Chart this week with 'Rein Me In', while new entries from BTS and Noah Kahan shake up the Top 40.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at #1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' reigns supreme on the Official Singles Chart. Is it your favourite track right now?

angles.name: New Entries
angles.copy: New music alert on the Official Singles Chart! BTS and Noah Kahan are among the fresh entries this week. What are you streaming?

moments.title: Camp Bestival Dorset Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Camp Bestival Dorset, the family-friendly festival, starts tomorrow, July 30th, running until August 2nd with a host of music and activities.

angles.name: Festival Fun
angles.copy: Get ready for glitter, music & family fun! Camp Bestival Dorset kicks off tomorrow, bringing four days of festival vibes. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Summer Festival
angles.copy: Another amazing UK festival starts this week! Camp Bestival Dorset runs from July 30th to August 2nd. What's your top festival memory?

moments.title: Kendal Calling & Green Gathering Start
moments.blurb: Two more major UK festivals, Kendal Calling and Green Gathering in Chepstow, Wales, also begin tomorrow, July 30th, offering diverse music and experiences.

angles.name: Northern Fest Vibes
angles.copy: If you're heading north, Kendal Calling starts tomorrow! Four days of music and good times in the Lake District. Who's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Welsh Festival
angles.copy: Green Gathering in Chepstow kicks off tomorrow! A fantastic eco-friendly festival bringing music and community to Wales. Have you been before?

moments.title: Luke Combs at Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: Country music superstar Luke Combs brings his 'My Kinda Saturday Night Tour' to Wembley Stadium for a three-night residency starting Friday, July 31st, with special guests including Thomas Rhett.

angles.name: Country Comes to Wembley
angles.copy: Yee-haw! Luke Combs hits Wembley Stadium for three nights starting Friday. Get ready for some serious country rock. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Wembley Weekend
angles.copy: It's a huge weekend at Wembley as Luke Combs takes over for three nights! Expect massive hits and an incredible atmosphere. What's your favourite Luke Combs song?

moments.title: Scottish Premiership Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Scottish Premiership season begins on Saturday, August 1st, with Dundee United facing Rangers in one of the opening fixtures.

angles.name: Scottish Football Returns
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Scottish Premiership kicks off this Saturday. Dundee United vs Rangers is one of the big opening games. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: New Season Excitement
angles.copy: Football is back in Scotland this weekend! The Premiership season gets underway on August 1st. What team are you most excited to see play?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Charli XCX
moments.blurb: British pop trailblazer Charli XCX turns 34 on Sunday, August 2nd.

angles.name: Pop Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Future pop icon Charli XCX turns 34 this Sunday! What's your favourite track from the 'Boom Clap' hitmaker?

angles.name: Celebrating Charli
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 34th Birthday to Charli XCX on August 2nd! Her influence on modern pop is undeniable. What's her best album?

moments.title: Happy Birthday James Hetfield
moments.blurb: Metallica frontman and co-founder James Hetfield celebrates his 63rd birthday on Monday, August 3rd.

angles.name: Metal Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Raise your horns! James Hetfield of Metallica turns 63 on Monday. What's your ultimate Metallica anthem?

angles.name: Hetfield's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to James Hetfield on August 3rd! The voice of a generation for metal fans. What's your favourite Metallica album?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Ian Broudie
moments.blurb: Ian Broudie, the mastermind behind The Lightning Seeds, celebrates his 68th birthday on Tuesday, August 4th.

angles.name: Indie Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds on Tuesday! Responsible for some absolute 90s classics. What's your top Lightning Seeds track?

angles.name: Football's Coming Home
angles.copy: The man who gave us 'Three Lions' (among many other hits)! Wishing Ian Broudie a very Happy 68th Birthday on August 4th.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Pat Smear
moments.blurb: Legendary guitarist Pat Smear, known for his work with Foo Fighters, Nirvana, and The Germs, turns 67 on Wednesday, August 5th.

angles.name: Rock Royalty Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the incredible Pat Smear on Wednesday! From The Germs to Nirvana to Foo Fighters, what a career. What's your favourite band he's been in?

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Wishing a huge Happy Birthday to guitarist Pat Smear on August 5th! A true rock legend. What's his most iconic riff?

moments.blurb: Schools across England and Wales are currently on their summer break, which typically runs until early September, while Scottish schools will return mid-August.

moments.title: The Hundred August Weekend Fixtures
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament enters August with key weekend matches including Birmingham Phoenix vs Welsh Fire on Aug 1st and Trent Rockets vs Sunrisers Leeds on Aug 2nd.

angles.copy: The Hundred rolls into August with a packed weekend! Birmingham Phoenix host Welsh Fire on Saturday, and Trent Rockets take on Sunrisers Leeds on Sunday. Who are you watching?

angles.copy: Welsh Fire are on the road this Saturday, August 1st, facing Birmingham Phoenix in The Hundred! Send them your support!
